EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE POLONNARUWAMUNICIPAL COUNCIL UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONSORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of return member of Polonnaruwa Municipal Council has fallen vacant by reason of Death ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the United National Party, the recognized political party to which MohamaduIbraheem Mohamadu Arfa the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(1) of the aforesaid ordinance, todecide upon returned member of United National Party who belongs to such party and is not disqualified under section9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared selected as a member within a period of thirty(30) days ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party has communicated his decision tonominate Jayasundara Korale Mudiyanse Ralahamilage Sujeewa Nishantha Gunathilaka to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE, I, Leelanath Wickrama Arachchi, Returning Officer of the Polonnaruwa Municipal Council,acting in terms of Section 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare thatJayasundara Korale Mudiyanse Ralahamilage Sujeewa Nishantha Gunathilaka was selected as the member of the PolonnaruwaMunicipal Council.
LEELANATH WICKRAMA ARACHCHI,Returning Officer,Polonnaruwa Municipal Council.District Election Office,Polonnaruwa,28th October, 2019.
Notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance
